blocks.text: Setting up your Mac for Gmail efficiency

Because Google does not offer a native Gmail desktop app, you should create a web app. In Safari, go to File > Add to Dock. This gives you a standalone icon in your Dock. If you use Chrome, go to the three dots menu > Save and Share > Create Shortcut. This helps you keep your customer success email separate from your personal tabs.
Mastering Gmail keyboard shortcuts for Mac

Shortcuts turn your inbox into a command center. Go to Settings > General > Keyboard shortcuts to enable them. Once enabled, you can use keys to move through messages. Press ? to see the full list of commands. Use j to move down and k to move up. Press c to compose a new email.

blocks.text: Customer success associates often handle hundreds of emails. Use labels to categorize your accounts. Create labels for Onboarding, QBR, and Renewal. You can create filters to automatically move emails from specific domains into these labels. This keeps your Primary inbox clean for urgent requests.
Using Lazur to handle email tasks

Lazur helps you stay in your flow. When you are stuck on a complex email, hold fn to dictate your reply. Lazur formats the text for you. If you need to find a specific setting, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask where it is. Lazur will point to the button on your screen.

The hardest part of your day is switching between your CRM and Gmail. Use Lazur to perform quick research. Ask Lazur to summarize a thread or find an account detail. This saves you from clicking through multiple tabs and losing your place.

faq.question: Is there an official Gmail app for Mac?
faq.answer: No. Google does not provide a native desktop app. You can create a web app using Safari or Chrome to simulate the experience.

faq.question: How do I make Gmail faster on my Mac?
faq.answer: Enable keyboard shortcuts in your settings. This allows you to navigate and manage your inbox without relying on your mouse.

faq.question: Can Lazur help me write emails?
faq.answer: Yes. Hold the fn key to dictate your response directly into the Gmail compose window. Lazur handles the formatting for you.
